treatment.schedule_summary: Dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily plus trametinib 2 mg once daily, continuously. A 28-day assessment convention does not create a break. Advanced melanoma: until progression/unacceptable toxicity. Completely resected Stage III adjuvant melanoma: 12 months unless recurrence/unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.cycle_convention_note: Continuous daily oral treatment. 28 days is an administrative assessment convention, not a drug-free interval.
treatment.administration: Swallow whole with water 1 hour before or 2 hours after food. Do not crush, chew or mix with food/liquids. Take trametinib with the morning or evening dabrafenib dose at the same time daily. Missed dabrafenib: only take if >6 hours to the next dose; trametinib: only if >12 hours. Do not replace a vomited trametinib dose.
treatment.dose_reduction_reference: Dabrafenib 150 →100 →75 →50 mg twice daily; trametinib 2 →1.5 →1 →1 mg daily. Lower doses are not recommended in this combination. Confirm actual dose history; no automatic dose calculation.

baseline: Dermatologic evaluation for other skin cancer
Review head/neck and non-cutaneous malignancy surveillance
during: FBC, renal and liver profile monthly
ECG and echocardiogram after the first 4 weeks, then every 12 weeks and after dose modification; confirm individual cycle timing
Skin surveillance: tests section says every 60 days; complication section says monthly. Confirm local dermatology schedule
Head/neck examination every 3 months; chest CT every 6 months in the tests section; broader chest/abdomen surveillance is described in complications
Review visual symptoms; creatinine, pancreatitis and other investigations when indicated
after: Skin and non-cutaneous malignancy surveillance up to 6 months after stopping or until another antineoplastic therapy, according to the source and individual plan
monitoring.disease_monitoring: Individual consultant plan; no universal tumour-marker panel or response-imaging interval is specified.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00415 v5 p6: dabrafenib moderate-to-high; trametinib minimal-to-low. Use local oral antiemetic policy.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
other_supportive_care: No specific routine supportive medicine is mandated by the regimen; apply local antiemetic and symptom protocols.
Pyrexia: clinician-directed antipyretics; consider oral corticosteroids if insufficient.
Alternative effective contraception during treatment, for 2 weeks after dabrafenib and 16 weeks after the last trametinib dose in this combination; hormonal contraception may be less effective.
Discuss fertility preservation; impaired spermatogenesis may be irreversible.

source_conflicts.resolution: Tests p2 specifies every 60 days; complications p6 specifies monthly. Preserve both with local-team reconciliation rather than silently choose a universal interval.

patient_warnings: Fever38°C or higher: interrupt both medicines and contact the treatment team; recurrence can prompt interruption at first symptoms. A treatment-team restart decision requires at least24hours completely symptom-free.
Report new vision change, light sensitivity or eye pain promptly.
Report new/worsening breathlessness or cough, severe rash/blistering/peeling, unexplained abdominal pain, markedly reduced urine or dehydration urgently.
Show all medicines/supplements to pharmacy. Dabrafenib can reduce hormonal contraceptive efficacy; warfarin INR and digoxin monitoring may need adjustment during and after treatment.
Discuss fertility before treatment and alternative contraception during treatment and for source-specific post-treatment periods.

treatment.schedule_summary: Encorafenib 450 mg once daily plus binimetinib 45 mg twice daily, 12 hours apart, continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity. The 28-day review convention is not a treatment break.
treatment.cycle_convention_note: Continuous daily oral treatment. 28 days is an administrative assessment convention, not a drug-free interval.

components.note: 12 hours apart; treatment table overrides opening once-daily prose.

treatment.administration: Normally swallow whole with water, with or without food; avoid grapefruit juice. Pharmacy-confirmed swallowing alternatives: Braftovi capsules may be opened in approximately 20 mL apple sauce and taken immediately; Mektovi 15 mg tablets may be dispersed in approximately 10 mL water/orange/apple juice, taken immediately, then rinse with approximately 10 mL and drink. Do not infer dispersion for the 45 mg tablet. Missed encorafenib: take only if >12 hours to next dose. Missed binimetinib: do not take if <6 hours to next dose. Do not replace either dose after vomiting.
treatment.dose_reduction_reference: Starting encorafenib 450 mg daily / binimetinib 45 mg twice daily; first reduction 300 mg /30 mg twice daily. The printed encorafenib second-reduction unit is erroneous and requires clarification; no automatic numeric second reduction. Limited encorafenib 100 mg data; stop if intolerant of 100 mg or binimetinib 30 mg twice daily.

baseline: Dermatologic evaluation for other skin cancer
during: FBC, renal and liver profile monthly
CK and creatinine monthly for the first 6 months, then as clinically indicated
ECG at initiation, after 4 weeks, then every 12 weeks and after dose modification
LVEF by echocardiogram/MUGA every 3 months or more often as indicated
Blood pressure during treatment; visual symptom review at each visit
Dermatology every 60 days; head/neck every 3 months; chest CT every 6 months
Closer monitoring for mild hepatic impairment and tumour lysis risk; additional tests follow symptoms and the clinical plan
after: Dermatology for up to 6 months after discontinuation; other surveillance follows the consultant plan

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Current NCCP 00563 v4 p8: both components moderate-to-high; follow local oral antiemetic policy.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
other_supportive_care: Use locally prescribed antiemetics and symptom support; no universal prophylactic medicine doses are stated.
Adequate fluid intake and clinician-directed CK/renal monitoring; consider prophylactic hydration for tumour lysis risk.
Effective contraception during treatment and at least 1 month after the last dose. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may fall: use an additional or alternative effective method as directed.
Discuss potential impaired spermatogenesis, fertility preservation and fetal harm risk.

source_conflicts.resolution: Table 2 prints 225g once daily; this is unsafe to operationalise. Do not silently change to 225 mg or retain the prior v3 200 mg. Pharmacy/source confirmation is required before a second reduction.

Opening treatment prose says both medicines once daily, but the actual treatment table and 12-hour instruction specify binimetinib 45 mg twice daily. Use the explicit table and retain this discrepancy.

Table 3 permits Grade 2 recovery/reduced restart after up to 4 weeks; p10 says permanently discontinue confirmed treatment-related ILD. Maintain hold and require documented clinical/pharmacy reconciliation before restart.
The printed Grade 3 liver row requires AST/ALT >5 AND bilirubin >2 ×ULN. Values >5–≤20 with bilirubin ≤2 have no exact row; flag review rather than invent a dose or imply clearance.

support_phases.drug_dose_policy: Local antiemetic policy; do not invent universal prophylaxis doses

patient_warnings: Promptly report new or worsening blurred vision, eye pain or other visual symptoms.
Report breathlessness/cough, chest symptoms/fainting, unexplained bleeding, painful swollen leg, marked muscle pain/weakness/dark urine, severe skin symptoms or jaundice urgently.
Maintain the individual advised fluid plan; risk-based monitoring/hydration may be needed for tumour lysis, especially high disease burden or renal impairment.
Avoid grapefruit juice; take only the exact prescribed tablet/capsule formulation. Ask pharmacy about swallowing alternatives; the source dispersion option is specific to Mektovi15mgtablets.
Hormonal contraception can become less effective. Use effective additional/alternative contraception during treatment and for at least1month after the last dose; discuss fertility.

evidence_context.interpretation: Do not present this advanced-melanoma regimen as a source-supported adjuvant course or transfer survival figures from a different targeted combination.
